slides.title: What is diabetes?
slides.text: Diabetes is a medical condition marked by chronic high blood sugar levels caused by low insulin production. While diabetes can be a lifelong health issue, it can be managed with proper medication and appropriate lifestyle changes.

slides.title: Types of diabetes
slides.text:
Prediabetes
Blood glucose levels are elevated, but not yet high enough to be considered Type 2 diabetes.

slides.title: Signs and symptoms
slides.text:
Feeling very thirsty
Individuals with diabetes may experience thirst more often, especially at night.
Symptom here

slides.title: Diagnosis
slides.text:
Bloodwork
Simple lab tests, like a fasting blood draw, can be used to make or rule out a diagnosis.
Discussion point here
Proper diagnosis is one of the first steps to dealing with any chronic illness, including diabetes.

slides.title: Lifestyle and Prevention
slides.text:
Adjust your diet
Swap simple carbohydrates for complex alternatives and reduce sugar intake.
Lifestyle change here
